purpose: Research registry of external G2P/IPA comparator systems and IPA/source-script display fonts. Entries are not active runtime dependencies; system smoke results are not pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

candidates.name: Goruut
candidates.kind: multilingual IPA phonemizer with lexicon/model fallback
candidates.upstream_support_claim: Upstream README lists Thai support and claims IPA output with tonal phones.
candidates.output: Pinned upstream commit executed on 36 engineering inputs in run 40129230641: 26 non-empty outputs and 10 per-input failures. Artifact SHA-256 192950f4bd426f3c274a78ab135072546225931003d59acd9ed7dd036dc4ef2a. Inter-engine exact agreement is 13/88 pairs; delimiter/tone-stripped comparisons are diagnostics only. Raw forms differ materially (e.g. กา -> ka versus /kaː˧/); segmentation, tone/length conventions and model/dictionary provenance remain unresolved. Independent gold count is zero; accuracy is null.
candidates.license: Upstream repository reports MIT; per-language dictionary/model data provenance and licensing have not been independently audited.
candidates.integration_note: Optional CI-only HTTP comparator; not a production dependency and not gold. Raw Word.Phonetic strings are preserved. Smoke success verifies endpoint execution only; output convention, tone/length completeness, word/syllable boundaries and model/dictionary provenance remain unresolved.
candidates.status_note: Previous execution classification (SMOKE_VERIFIED_PARTIAL_COVERAGE_NOT_ACCURACY) is retained as execution_status; status uses the schema's controlled candidate vocabulary.

benchmark_protocol.scoring_gate: Only independently adjudicated, non-empty gold_ipa rows are scored.
benchmark_protocol.notes: Registry membership does not establish language support, IPA output semantics, reproducibility, accuracy, or license compatibility. Preserve raw output and record exact versions and model/data licenses.

observed_experiments.configuration: base engine; optional thaiphon-data-volubilis lexicon not installed

observed_experiments.notes: No gold labels. `ไกล`: thaiphon splits into /kaj˧/ /la˦˥/, FastThaiG2P returns /klaj˧/. `จริง`: thaiphon returns /tɕa˨˩/ /ri˦˥/ /ŋa˦˥/, FastThaiG2P returns /t͡ɕiŋ˧/. These are high-priority lexical/segmentation disagreements, not a winner determination.
Tone-stripped metric is diagnostic only. Exact inter-engine agreement is not correctness; Wiktionary source spot-check is selected and not independently adjudicated.

Inspected artifact. Goruut returned 26 non-empty strings and 10 per-input errors. Example กา: thaiphon/FastThaiG2P output /kaː˧/, Goruut output ka. Some outputs lack explicit tone/length notation or word/syllable separators. These are raw format/coverage observations, not adjudicated phonological errors; inter-engine agreement is not accuracy.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream reports ~57% exact match base engine and ~75% with optional thaiphon-data-volubilis on its own Wiktionary-derived corpus, and ~73% on a PyThaiNLP G2P cross-check.
upstream_evidence.caveat: These denominators and conventions differ from ClippyFirst; do not compare directly to our unscored 36-item smoke run. The lexicon is separately CC-BY-SA 4.0; engine code is Apache-2.0.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream describes a 62,112-word IPA dictionary plus rule-based fallback and reports generated IPA entries among sources.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Review dictionary source overlap, generated-label provenance, and dataset licenses before treating as a gold resource.

upstream_evidence.fact: README lists Thai among supported languages and labels output phone set IPA.
upstream_evidence.caveat: No pinned Thai output or gold evaluation in this repository.

scope_note: Historical filename: this registry catalogs both external G2P/IPA comparison systems and display fonts. Fonts are rendering assets, not pronunciation engines.

status_semantics.verified_in_repo: true means the candidate's pronunciation behavior has been validated against project-approved independent gold. A successful smoke or upstream language-support claim does not set this flag.
status_semantics.execution_status: Records whether a candidate was run, blocked, or only reported upstream; it is independent of verified_in_repo.
